Post 1
📉 ASX 200 broke below its 200-day moving average Thursday, closing at 8,793.20, down 0.43%. Energy and Materials led the selling. Up 0.84% over five days but flat YTD — momentum is fading fast. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🔻 Energy -2.42%, Materials -1.96%, Consumer Discretionary -1.72% dragged the index. Industrials +0.90% and A-REITs +0.76% held firm. A defensive rotation quietly underway. #ASX #energy #mining

Post 3
NCK collapsed 15.34% to AUD 12.03 — the sharpest single-stock blow of the session. Nick Scali's drop signals consumer spending stress hitting discretionary retail hard right now. #ASX #ausbiz #retail

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 5,859.99/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7012. Silver AUD 80.28/oz. Metals priced richly in local terms — yet Materials shed 1.96%. USD strength is doing the heavy lifting here. #gold #silver #metals #ASX

Post 5
The 200-day MA breach is the line in the sand. Can 8,793 hold, or does the index retest lower? Watch Energy and Materials overnight — if commodity prices don't stabilise, sellers stay in control. Where do you see support? #ASX #ausbiz #technicalanalysis
